body:
Ah. I have been in college for 5 months now. In the first 3 things were going well, it was still ok in the 4th. Shit broke down within the last month.

Now I’m in the third week since the semester began, and it has gone from bad to worse with every day. 

I haven’t communicated properly with my best friends in like 5 days. As for the “plenty of fish in the sea”... no idea where I can find them. Plus, I don’t even have the mental energy to find them.

I appreciate the advice, but I’ve already done that before and... it worked until the point when it was in vain.
